title: Gâteaux de maïs (Steamed Maize and Peanut Cakes)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Uncrushed, unsoaked maize flour toasted in a very hot pot until golden, mixed with peanut paste, oil, salt, chilli, optional shrimp and a little water, wrapped as balls in banana leaves and steamed about an hour.
longDesc: p. 6 of the October 2023 recipe book describes a traditional dish of maize flour ‘sweetened, salted and steamed’. The ingredient list and steps, however, contain no sugar. The flour is toasted in a very hot pot to a golden colour and moved to another pot; peanut paste, oil, salt, crushed chilli, optional shrimp and a small amount of water are stirred in to a slightly heavy, homogeneous paste. Small portions are wrapped as balls in banana leaves and steamed about an hour. No quantities are printed.
ingredients: Maize flour (uncrushed, unsoaked) — quantity not printed
steps: Toast the maize flour in a very hot pot until golden. Move it to another pot.
Add the peanut paste, oil, salt, chilli, shrimp and a small amount of water.
Stir to a slightly heavy, homogeneous paste.
Wrap small portions as balls in banana leaves.
chefTips: Printed cues: golden colour of the toasted flour; ‘slightly heavy and homogeneous’ paste.
The book describes the cake as sweetened but prints no sugar.
All quantities are absent — start with a small batch.
commonMistakes: Adding too much water so the balls will not hold.
Adding sugar on the strength of the description alone.
healthBenefits: Maize and peanuts give carbohydrate, protein and fat.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe. The description says ‘sucrée’ and the flow diagram lists sugar and palm oil; the ingredient list prints neither (refined oil only). Reported unreconciled.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Gâteaux de maïs’ (p. 6). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 8, prep 30 are placeholders. TWO-PASS.
DISCREPANCY inside the source: description and diagram mention sugar and palm oil, the list and steps do not. ABSENT: every quantity.
